description: Source code for the ICM42688 sensor decoder, including functions for decoding FIFO and one-shot data, encoding channels, and handling sensor data conversions.

methods.name: icm42688_get_shift
methods.description: Determines the shift value based on sensor channel and full scale settings.

methods.name: icm42688_convert_raw_to_q31
methods.description: Converts raw sensor readings to Q31 fixed-point format.

methods.name: icm42688_get_channel_position
methods.description: Returns the position index of a sensor channel.

methods.name: icm42688_encode
methods.description: Encodes sensor channels into a buffer with header information.

methods.name: icm42688_read_temperature_from_packet
methods.description: Extracts temperature data from a FIFO packet.

methods.name: icm42688_read_imu_from_packet
methods.description: Reads accelerometer or gyroscope data from a FIFO packet.

methods.name: icm42688_fifo_decode
methods.description: Decodes FIFO buffer data into sensor readings.

methods.name: icm42688_one_shot_decode
methods.description: Decodes single-shot sensor data into structured format.

methods.name: icm42688_decoder_decode
methods.description: Main decode function that delegates to FIFO or one-shot decode.

methods.name: icm42688_decoder_get_frame_count
methods.description: Calculates the number of frames in a FIFO buffer.

methods.name: icm42688_decoder_get_size_info
methods.description: Provides size information for sensor data frames.

methods.name: icm24688_decoder_has_trigger
methods.description: Checks if a trigger condition is met in FIFO data.

methods.name: icm42688_get_decoder
methods.description: Returns the sensor decoder API for ICM42688.
